lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs posterior to the gill slits are arranged in a quasi-rectilinear grid; distinct clusters of large-diameter spots are visible in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the lateral spots to form a matrix of nodal points across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel longitudinal ridges on the dorsal-lateral surface exhibit sharp vertical luminance gradients, with high intensity on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of jagged, semi-circular notches and irregular tissue loss are visible along the posterior distal margin of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal Echeneidae (remoras) positioned ventrally and posterior to the left pectoral fin.
